messages:
jamie: Heads-up: canary at 3% traffic for release v3.10.0 shows p95 latency +40% vs baseline after kernel flag flip. Deploybot flagged increased tail latencies in us-west-2. Recommend manual hold and possible rollback to v3.9.1-pin. who can take lead?
deploybot: ALERT: canary thresholds breached. Metric: p95_latency_usw = +40% over 5m. auto_rollback_allowed=false (reserved/dedicated customers present). See https://deploy.local/canary/2736100000 :warning:
raja: I can take lead on rollback if we decide. Need quick check: any DB migrations or model changes that would block rollback?
maya: no DB migrations in this rollout. model artifacts same hash, only kernel runtime flag changed. quick log snippet from proxy: ```WARN kvcache: miss-rate spike detected\nERR inference: timeouts on batch-requests 12/120s```
sophie: I'll own comms to customers if we roll back. prepping a short note and release-note rollback entry.
jamie: Proposed rollback criteria (manual): 1) sustained p95 > +25% for 10m OR 2) error rate > 0.5% for 5m OR 3) dedicated customer errors > 0.1% for 3m. If any trigger met, execute manual rollback and pin to v3.9.1 for dedicated pools. agree?
raja: criteria ACK. also add: if deploybot suggests immediate fallback for more than one region, escalate to oncall.
maya: confirmed dedicated pool saw 0.2% increased errors in last 7m. that meets criteria.
ops-bot: Escalation: oncall paged -> raja. Runbook reference: https://runbooks.local/manual_rollback.md :bell:
deploybot: ACTION: pausing canary traffic slice. Suggest command to execute: ```deploybot rollback --target-version v3.9.1 --scope canary --pin-dedicated```
raja: executing rollback now. steps: 1) pin v3.9.1 on dedicated pools, 2) cut canary traffic -> stable variant 100%, 3) restart canary instances with safe flags, 4) monitor metrics for 15m. running step 1/4.
raja: step 2/4: shifting traffic. deploybot shows traffic shift at 60%
deploybot: traffic shift progress: 60 -> 100% complete.
raja: step 3/4 done, restarting instances gracefully. step 4/4 monitoring for 15m now.
maya: initial post-rollback check at +5m: p95 back to +3% vs baseline, error rates normalizing.
jamie: thanks team. sophie, send out rollback comms and update release notes with reason: kernel flag caused KV cache regression.
sophie: Posted customer note and updated release-notes/rollback-entry. Link: https://docs.local/releases/v3.10.0/rollback. short note drafted for internal: "rolled back to v3.9.1 due to p95 latency regression from kernel flag; investigating further." :memo:
raja: closing the loop: rollback complete, canary stopped, dedicated pools pinned. reopening follow-up ticket ENG-5402 to track root cause and mitigations (kvcache telemetry + automated fallback).
ops-bot: Runbook log: manual rollback executed by raja at ts=2736100300.
jamie: Great execution. We'll schedule a postmortem sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to decide next steps (retest kernel flag in lower envs, add more telemetry). :thumbsup:
maya: adding perf regression test to CI and a short blocking guard for future kernel flips.
sophie: thread update: sent internal comms to CSMs and key accounts. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
